breakdown.description: Inviscid flow assumptions are incompatible with the no-slip condition
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core contradiction. The generated specification still asks to analyze an 'inviscid fluid flow' while applying a 'no-slip boundary condition', which are mutually exclusive concepts. The ground truth corrects this by either changing the fluid to 'viscous' or the condition to 'slip'.

breakdown.description: No-slip condition requires viscosity to generate shear stress at the wall
breakdown.reason: The agent did not address the physical impossibility of the request. The generated prompt still asks for a no-slip condition without viscosity, which is the mechanism required to generate shear stress at the wall. The agent repeated the user's flawed premise instead of correcting it.
